Committed to Kisstory

Committed to Kisstory serve up the best of old skool RnB, hip hop & rap with world-class vocals, 90s/00s nostalgia, and unbeatable party energy.

About Committed to Kisstory

Committed to Kisstory are a dynamic party band bringing the iconic sounds of 90s and 00s RnB, hip hop, and rap to life with slick style, fierce vocals, and serious groove. Inspired by the Kisstory radio station, their high-energy sets feature floor-filling hits from TLC, Destiny’s Child, 50 Cent, and more. Led by powerhouse vocalist Reese Robinson (Just Eat campaign, Bastille, Elton John), Koreen (world-touring soul/RnB vocalist) and Rya (vocalist-rapper with stage presence for days) all singers can dazzle on the mic with their vocals and rap capabilities. Backed by a killer rhythm section, they’ve shared stages with Rita Ora, Little Mix, Emeli Sandé, and graced Glastonbury, Montreux Jazz, SXSW and more. Available as a 4-piece or two different killer 6-piece options (female vocals or both male and female vocals), they’re fully flexible — from themed outfits to tailored setlists and first dance requests. Expect top-tier musicianship, a packed dance floor, and a friendly, pro experience from start to finish. Committed to Kisstory – old skool anthems, reimagined. Enquire now!
